parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the bandwidth plan is attached.

parameters.name: GeographicRegionAId
parameters.description:
The ID of one of the connected areas of the bandwidth plan instance. Valid values:

- **China**: the Chinese mainland.
- **North-America**: North America.
- **Asia-Pacific**: Asia Pacific.
- **Europe**: Europe.

parameters.name: GeographicRegionBId
parameters.description:
The ID of the other connected areas of the bandwidth plan instance. Valid values:

- **China**: the Chinese mainland.
- **North-America**: North America.
- **Asia-Pacific**: Asia Pacific.
- **Europe**: Europe.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
